name: gunslinger-grit-spending
description: The product's own guarded deed scenarios, run in the disposable game copy to show that grit is still shown and gated through the shared indicator and still spent exactly once by each deed's own transaction. Covered: the action-bar count and the indicator's no-op Spend (grit resource); a deed with its own resource logic (Deadeye); a deed that spends when used through its transaction and has no resource field on its ability (Dead Shot); and deeds that arm a marker and spend later (Expert Loading, Slinger's Luck for both the saving-throw and the skill-check variant). Each launch is a fresh process. Two related scenarios are left out because they do not give a stable verdict in this copy. disposable-gunslinger-dodge errors before its assertions, and does so on the published v0.0.190 package as well. In disposable-pistolero-deeds one damage assertion is intermittent on the repaired candidate; its cause is not established, and every recorded Pistolero grit assertion passed. See docs/GUNSLINGER-GRIT-UI-RECIPIENT-REPAIR.md.
